svg.text: NimbleCart — how the package fits together
A narrated pandas pipeline for a fictional dark-store grocery business. Each box gives the name, then what it actually does. Read the bands top to bottom: that is also the import order.
1 · HOW YOU RUN IT · entry points, flags and outputs · the monolith is nimblecart_availability_pipeline.py, the package is nimblecart/
2 · THE FOUNDATION · constants and contracts, which import nothing local
3 · THE FIVE SOURCE TABLES · generated, written to CSV, then read back on purpose
4 · TYPED INGEST · the one door, with a validator on it
5 · THE PILLARS · each module takes frames and hands on a named frame, in dependency order
6 · MEASURING AND PRESENTING · the three fixes, and the traps they exist to replace
7 · THE ADVANCED MODULES · what the monolith still does not cover, imported lazily
8 · WHY THE PACKAGE EXISTS · the teaching frame and its own rules
R · THE IMPORT SPINE · strictly one direction
